source_title: Alibaba Open-Sources Page Agent: In-Page GUI Agent for Natural Language Web Control

discovered_urls.context: Primary repo for Page Agent — in-page JavaScript GUI agent by Alibaba; 5,795 stars (MIT); TypeScript; text-based DOM manipulation + BYOK LLM; zero backend required; catalogued as agent-harnesses/page-agent.md
discovered_urls.relevance_hint: 7/10 relevance — strongest SaaS factory application: drop-in AI copilot for any web app in 3 lines of code. BYOK + antigravity proxy compatible. No orchestration value, but high delivery value for gov SaaS client-facing features.

discovered_urls.context: Official Page Agent documentation — integration patterns, model configuration (DashScope/Qwen native + OpenAI-compatible BYOK), Chrome extension setup, human-in-the-loop UI customization
discovered_urls.relevance_hint: Worth ingesting if we decide to evaluate Page Agent for SaaS factory integration — practical integration patterns and HITL UI docs are the most actionable sections

discovered_urls.context: Acknowledged ancestor of Page Agent in README — DOM processing components and prompts derived from browser-use (MIT, Gregor Zunic). Server-side counterpart to Page Agent's client-side approach.
discovered_urls.relevance_hint: Not yet in catalogue; server-side browser automation with Python; lower priority than Page Agent for our zero-infra stack but worth a pass if we need server-controlled web interaction
